records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales decreased 15% due to (i) the loss of net sales as a result of the Wine and Spirits Divestitures, (ii) a decrease in Beer net sales driven primarily by a shipment volume decline, partially offset by a favorable impact from pricing, and (iii) a decline in organic Wine and Spirits net sales driven by changes in financial and volume related contractual obligations with distributors.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales decreased 10% due to (i) the loss of net sales as a result of the Wine and Spirits Divestitures, (ii) a decrease in Beer net sales driven primarily by a shipment volume decline, partially offset by a favorable impact from pricing, and (iii) a decline in organic Wine and Spirits net sales driven by changes in financial and volume related contractual obligations with distributors.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Largely in connection with the 2025 Wine Divestitures we recognized contract liabilities and inventory obsolescence expenses, partially offset by changes in then-existing net assets held for sale (Six Months 2026).

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our business strategy for the Wine and Spirits segment continues to focus on delivering growth and improving margins beyond Fiscal 2026 by driving our higher-end brands and operating efficiencies.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income increased 171% largely due to a Second Quarter 2025 Wine and Spirits goodwill impairment and a successful execution of efficiency and cost optimization initiatives within the Beer segment, partially offset by the (i) loss of net sales as a result of the Wine and Spirits Divestitures and (ii) declines in Beer and organic Wine and Spirits segments net sales.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In fiscal year 2024, approximately 39% of our sales were generated outside of the U.S. We also are partners in a number of joint ventures involved in the manufacture and sale of flavorful products, the most significant of which is McCormick de Mexico.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Volume and product mix favorably impacted net sales by 1.2%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Excluding the impact of special charges related to the step up of acquired inventory included in cost of goods sold, adjusted gross margin was 37.5% for the third quarter of 2025.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our gross profit margin decreased by 130 basis points primarily driven by increased commodity costs including the impact of tariffs, and increased conversion costs including costs to support capacity for future growth, partially offset by CCI-led cost savings.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income was $288.7 million in the third quarter of 2025, compared to $286.5 million in the same period of 2024, reflecting an increase of 0.8%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue increased 3% in the first quarter of 2026 primarily due to base yield improvements, higher volume, and favorable exchange rates at Federal Express, partially offset by the expiration of our contract with the USPS, lower fuel surcharges, and lower shipments and base yields at FedEx Freight.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consequently, this environment has led to lower shipments at FedEx Freight, negatively affecting our results in the first quarter of 2026.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The uncertain and evolving global trade environment has contributed to lower international export package volumes, negatively affecting our results in the first quarter of 2026.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the first quarter of 2026, lower fuel prices negatively affected yields due to lower fuel surcharges and led to reduced fuel expense at both of our transportation segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income increased 10% in the first quarter of 2026 primarily due to improved yields for our U.S. domestic and international priority package services, structural cost reductions from business optimization initiatives, including from DRIVE initiatives commenced in prior years, and higher U.S. domestic package demand at Federal Express.
